# 3D Printers: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation. Re-verify links and contents when updating this skill;
printer firmware and cloud behavior change often.

Last verified: 2026-10-30

## Vendor (authoritative)

### Bambu Lab

- Authorization control system announcement (affected operations, LAN mode, Bambu Connect):
  https://blog.bambulab.com/firmware-update-introducing-new-authorization-control-system-2/
- Updates and third-party integration with Bambu Connect (Developer Mode announcement):
  https://blog.bambulab.com/updates-and-third-party-integration-with-bambu-connect
- Enable Developer Mode (LAN Only prerequisite; opens MQTT, live stream, FTP; risk notice):
  https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/knowledge-sharing/enable-developer-mode
- Printer network ports (MQTT 8883, FTPS 990, video 6000/322, SSDP 1990/2021):
  https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/printer-network-ports
- Account multifactor authentication: https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/studio-handy/account-multifactor-authentication
- Firmware release notes: on the Bambu Lab wiki and download pages for each model.

### Prusa

- PrusaLink and Prusa Connect setup (local vs. cloud; supported printers):
  https://help.prusa3d.com/article/prusalink-and-prusa-connect-setup-mini-mk4-xl_302608
- PrusaLink authentication and remote-access guidance (digest default; no port forward; use a VPN), SL1
  article: https://help.prusa3d.com/article/prusa-local-connect-sl1_146094
- Firmware signature verification and custom firmware ("appendix"):
  https://help.prusa3d.com/article/signature-verification-failed-31606-core-one-35606-core-one-l-26606-mk4s-13606-mk4-27606-mk3-9s-21606-mk3-9-28606-mk3-5s-23606-mk3-5_401109

### OctoPrint

- Security advisories: https://github.com/OctoPrint/OctoPrint/security/advisories
- Security policy: https://github.com/OctoPrint/OctoPrint/security/policy
- Release notes: https://github.com/OctoPrint/OctoPrint/releases
- Safe remote access (maintainer's guide; 2018, still the reasoning behind "don't expose it"):
  https://octoprint.org/blog/2018/09/03/safe-remote-access/
- Access control and autologin: https://docs.octoprint.org/en/master/features/accesscontrol.html
- `config.yaml` reference (autologin, `localNetworks`, events, system actions):
  https://docs.octoprint.org/en/master/configuration/config_yaml.html
- Safe mode: https://docs.octoprint.org/en/master/features/safemode.html
- Discovery plugin (mDNS/SSDP announcements): https://docs.octoprint.org/en/master/bundledplugins/discovery.html

### Klipper, Moonraker, Mainsail, Fluidd

- Moonraker configuration (`[server]`, `[authorization]`, `[update_manager]`, `[mqtt]`, `[secrets]`,
  `[zeroconf]`, `[power]`): https://moonraker.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configuration/
- Moonraker security advisories: https://github.com/Arksine/moonraker/security/advisories
- Mainsail remote access (don't open Mainsail/Moonraker ports; VPN and trusted clients):
  https://docs.mainsail.xyz/faq/remote-access/
- Fluidd Moonraker configuration: https://docs.fluidd.xyz/configuration/moonraker
- Klipper configuration reference (`[verify_heater]`, `min_temp`/`max_temp`):
  https://www.klipper3d.org/Config_Reference.html

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents. The host computer is covered by the [Linux skill](../linux/SKILL.md)
and its references.

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- All3DP, "Bambu Lab Limits Third-Party Printer Control with New Security Update":
  https://all3dp.com/4/bambu-lab-limits-third-party-printer-control-with-new-security-update/
  News summary of the January 2025 authorization change; check Bambu's own posts for current behavior.
- SimplyPrint compatibility pages (for example https://simplyprint.io/compatibility/bambu-lab): what a
  third-party manager can do per mode; vendor-neutral but written by a competitor of the vendor apps.
- GitLab advisory database entry for a self-hosted Bambu management tool (CVE-2026-25505, hard-coded JWT
  key and unauthenticated routes): https://advisories.gitlab.com/pkg/pypi/bambuddy/CVE-2026-25505/
  An example of why self-hosted print managers need their own patching; check the project's own advisory.
- SANS Internet Storm Center reporting on internet-exposed OctoPrint instances (2018), summarized at
  https://www.securityweek.com/thousands-3d-printers-exposed-remote-attacks: historical context for
  exposure risk; numbers are dated.
